title: Actual completed-coefficient principal Koszul and quotient tensor towers
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, its valuation ring $A$ and uniformizer $t$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. For any scheme $W$ use the small pro-etale completed coefficient sheaf $R_W=\varprojlim_{m\geq1}(A/t^m)_W$ and its specified projections [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients], and let $\mathcal M_W=\operatorname{Mod}(R_W)$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Use the completed uniformizer section of [def-sp-completed-uniformizer-section]. For $n\in\mathbf N$ let $S_n$ be the actual constant quotient sheaf $(A/t^{n+1})_W$, restricted to $R_W$ along its specified projection, and let $\pi_n:R_W\to S_n$ send $1$ to $1$. Let $Q_n=[R_W\xrightarrow{t^{n+1}}R_W]$ in degrees $-1,0$, as the mapping cone on $R_W[0]$, with transition $(t,1)$ and augmentation $\epsilon_n:Q_n\to S_n[0]$ given by zero on the shifted source and $\pi_n$ on the degree-zero target. These use the principal constructions of [def-pur-principal-koszul-quotient-towers]; the quotient term here is the specified constant quotient, with its actual reduction transition. For every cochain complex $P$ in $\mathcal M_W$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] use the direct-sum total tensor [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves] to define the functor $T_P(C)=P\otimes_{R_W}C$, the strict towers $V(P)_n=T_P(Q_n)$ and $U(P)_n=T_P(S_n[0])$, and their strict comparison $a(P)_n=T_P(\epsilon_n)$. Tensor factor order is $P$ first. For every chain map $f:P\to P'$ define $V(f)$ and $U(f)$ by $f\otimes1$ in each level. These definitions impose no K-flatness, termwise flatness or boundedness condition on $P$; coefficient and scheme universes are independent.
